scope.note: scope correction, not a compatibility result: these Go behaviors are unverified for the candidate

excluded_tiers.full60s: real 60-second client deadline; opt-in with --include-full60s (per-case timeout 80 s)
excluded_tiers.known-divergence: documented unresolved Go/Rust diagnostics (see KNOWN_DIVERGENCES); opt-in, never counted as passes

known_divergences.p3-text-status-empty-reason-empty: HTTP/1.1 status line with an empty reason phrase: Go keeps the raw delimiter ('200 '), hyper does not expose it ('200')
known_divergences.p3-text-status-empty-reason-no-rows: HTTP/1.1 status line with an empty reason phrase: Go keeps the raw delimiter ('200 '), hyper does not expose it ('200')
known_divergences.p3-json-status-empty-reason-empty: HTTP/1.1 status line with an empty reason phrase: Go keeps the raw delimiter ('200 '), hyper does not expose it ('200')
known_divergences.p3-text-reset-mid-body: OS connection-reset wording: Go 'read tcp A->B: read: connection reset by peer', Rust 'Connection reset by peer (os error 104)'; code/retryability match
known_divergences.p3-text-close-before-headers: premature EOF before response headers: Go distinguishes diagnostics hyper cannot
known_divergences.p3-text-malformed-status-line: malformed status code: Go echoes the raw token ('abc'), hyper reports only 'invalid HTTP status-code parsed'
known_divergences.p3-json-reset-mid-body: OS connection-reset wording (see p3-text-reset-mid-body); partial stdout and code match
known_divergences.p3-status-299-text: HTTP/1.1 status line with an empty reason phrase: Go keeps the raw delimiter ('200 '), hyper does not expose it ('200') (299 has no standard reason)
known_divergences.p3-status-299-json: HTTP/1.1 status line with an empty reason phrase: Go keeps the raw delimiter ('200 '), hyper does not expose it ('200') (299 has no standard reason)
known_divergences.p3-status-empty-reason-text: HTTP/1.1 status line with an empty reason phrase: Go keeps the raw delimiter ('200 '), hyper does not expose it ('200')
known_divergences.p3-status-empty-reason-json: HTTP/1.1 status line with an empty reason phrase: Go keeps the raw delimiter ('200 '), hyper does not expose it ('200')
known_divergences.p3-status-empty-reason-empty-body: HTTP/1.1 status line with an empty reason phrase: Go keeps the raw delimiter ('200 '), hyper does not expose it ('200')
known_divergences.p3-argv-invalid-utf8-sql: non-UTF-8 argv rejected at the Rust String parser boundary (phase-one limitation)

exclusions: Interactive -i/--interactive: candidate-only zero-request boundary checks, not Go parity. Nonempty --save-as is covered by phase four.
TLS, certificate trust and HTTP proxies: covered by native Rust transport tests; loopback proxies are bypassed by Go.
HTTP/2, 1xx informational responses, Expect/100-continue and trailers are not scripted.
Spinner frame counts and timing are scheduler-dependent; frames are collapsed, order and cleanup are checked.
Known-divergence tier (opt-in, Go-pinned): empty HTTP reason phrases, OS connection-reset wording, premature header EOF and malformed status-code diagnostics, non-UTF-8 argv (see KNOWN_DIVERGENCES).
SIGQUIT and HTTP/2 are outside the current fixtures.
Real 60-second deadlines run only with --include-full60s (80 s per-case timeout).
Peak RSS/CPU are recorded per sample but do not gate; run.py benchmark workloads measure them.
Outputs over 16 MiB are compared by raw digest and size (no fixture URL/HOME appears in them).
